definitions.explanation: The act of meeting someone, especially for the first time or by chance. Often implies a meaningful or fateful encounter. The noun form of {出会|であ}う.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}との{出会|であ}いは{偶然|ぐうぜん}だった。
examples.english: My encounter with her was by chance.

examples.japanese: {人生|じんせい}を{変|か}える{出会|であ}いがあった。
examples.english: I had an encounter that changed my life.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{出会|であ}いを{大切|たいせつ}にしたい。
examples.english: I want to cherish new encounters.

notes:
USAGE: {出会|であ}い often implies a significant or meaningful meeting, not just a casual encounter. Commonly used in romantic contexts and stories about fate.

KANJI VARIANTS:
・{出会|であ}い - general use, emphasizes the meeting aspect
・{出合|であ}い - can also be used, sometimes emphasizes chance

COMMON PATTERNS:
・〜との{出会|であ}い (encounter with ~)
・{運命|うんめい}の{出会|であ}い (fateful encounter)
・{新|あたら}しい{出会|であ}い (new encounters)
・{出会|であ}いを{求|もと}める (to seek encounters/connections)

MODERN USAGE:
・{出会|であ}い{系|けい}サイト (dating site)
・{出会|であ}いの{場|ば} (place to meet people)

RELATED: The verb form is {出会|であ}う (to meet, to encounter).
